body.name: Cert
body.construction: On input normalized \(2\times2\) probability tables \((A,B)\), compute \((p,r,a,b)\), return incompatible exactly when either \(a-b<-(1-p)r\) or \(a-b>p(1-r)\), and otherwise return \((qL,qU)\) from their three-branch formulas. If all input cells are rational and the pair is compatible, also use \((c,d)=(cU,0)\) and \((c,d)=(cL,w11)\). For each endpoint pair set \(n_{00}=c\), \(n_{01}=a-c\), \(n_{10}=b-c\), and \(n_{11}=d\); set \(t_{ij}=n_{ij}/w_{ij}\) when \(w_{ij}>0\) and \(t_{ij}=0\) when \(w_{ij}=0\). Set \(\gamma_A=A(1,1)/(1-p)\) when \(1-p>0\) and \(\gamma_A=0\) when \(1-p=0\); set \(\gamma_B=B(1,1)/(1-r)\) when \(1-r>0\) and \(\gamma_B=0\) when \(1-r=0\). Use response probabilities \(t_{uv}\) when \((x,z)=(0,0)\), \(\gamma_A\) when \((x,z)=(1,0)\), \(\gamma_B\) when \((x,z)=(0,1)\), and \(1/2\) when \((x,z)=(1,1)\). Sort the distinct response probabilities together with \(\{0,1\}\) as \(0=\lambda_0<\cdots<\lambda_m=1\), give \(W0=k\) mass \(\lambda_k-\lambda_{k-1}\), take independent \(D\)-valued \(U0,V0\) with zero-probabilities \(p,r\), set \(fX(u)=u\), \(fZ(v)=v\), and set \(fY(x,z,u,v,k)=\mathbf 1\{\lambda_k\le h(x,z,u,v)\}\) for the specified response probability \(h\). Emit the resulting two models \(M\in MC(A,B)\) as lower- and upper-endpoint certificates.
